GPTR-F-001-S76.title: Request Schema Validation Layer
GPTR-F-001-S76.description: Implement strict request schema validation (query shape, collection name, filters, limits) using Pydantic or equivalent to ensure all incoming GPTReader requests conform to a predefined contract before allowlist enforcement is applied.

GPTR-F-001-S77.title: Negative Security Test Suite for Scope Enforcement
GPTR-F-001-S77.description: Develop comprehensive negative test cases including injection attempts, unauthorized collections, malformed queries, and boundary violations to validate that the allowlist enforcement consistently rejects invalid or unsafe requests.

GPTR-F-001-S78.title: Cross-Service Enforcement Boundary Validation
GPTR-F-001-S78.description: Validate that all internal invocation paths (including Brain runner, pipelines, and any direct function calls) pass through the enforcement layer, preventing bypass via internal service integration or alternate entry points.
